posts.hook: The AI jobs gap just got measurably worse
posts.caption: stanford's new numbers show ai hitting entry-level jobs harder than last year, musk says ai will become impossible for humans to control while admitting anthropic is winning, and the uk gets access to the same ukrainian targeting data that trained an ai drone to pick its own target. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
